verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm local speech transcription, but for meetings rather than voice-note chat input. A community hands-on comment says the product supports TTS/STT alongside its LLM stack, which implies dictation and spoken replies without documenting them. missing for 10: first-party docs on voice-note/dictation input in chat, documented spoken (TTS) replies, any evidence of live two-way voice conversation.
